explicit_mentions.text: #### Source CL and Realm Interaction

Elemental resistance, immunity, absorption, and terrain control compare Source CL only when they directly oppose the chosen element. Lower-Source-CL ordinary resistance can reduce damage but cannot prevent the non-damage rider of a failed save unless it expressly protects against that rider. Equal authority resolves the printed save and any Cultivation Check. A higher-authority elemental sovereign, artifact, or world-law effect may suppress one alignment without suppressing the other four. Use the shared Source CL bands for any direct contest not otherwise defined. Decisive lower-Realm authority does not bypass an explicit artifact, Immortal, Secret, conceptual, or named absolute protection.

Elemental contamination, petrification, burning meridians, flooded lungs, or metal poisoning caused by this Subpath uses the shared long-term harm rules at the feature’s Source CL. Ending or changing alignment ends only effects whose duration depends on the alignment; completed injuries remain until treated. Instantaneous results remain resolved even if the origin, field, Asset, or Anchor is later destroyed.

source.excerpt: ### CL3 — Light as a Feather Your long jump and high jump distances are tripled. Reduce falling damage you take by 5 × your Qi Cultivation CL. During your turn, you may move across water, ordinary liquids, snow, mud, loose sand, thin branches, fragile rooftops, unstable ground, hanging cloth, and similar surfaces as though stable ground when they can support at least 1 pound. If you end your turn on a surface incapable of supporting your actual weight and have no other support, you fall or sink normally. You do not trigger a fragile surface merely by crossing it during your turn unless a feature detects Qi pressure rather than weight.

### CL6 — Cloud Step Bonus Action Duration: 1 minute Concentration: Required Cost: 2 Qi For the duration: - Gain a Fly Speed of 20 feet. - You cannot Hover. - Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage. - Ignore nonmagical difficult terrain. - You may stand on mist, smoke, rain, or ordinary clouds during your turn. If your turn ends while airborne and you did not move at least 5 feet during that turn, descend up to 60 feet. If you reach a supporting surface, land standing. Otherwise remain airborne until the start of your next turn and then begin falling unless you move again or another feature supports you.

explicit_mentions.text: Seal Cultivators impose direct, named bindings through script, chains, marks, prison clauses, and formal authority. A seal functions because the cultivator has bound a specific movement, feature, meridian, object, or cultivation system and sustained that binding through Qi, an Anchor, or superior Source CL.

A complete cultivation seal is not prohibited merely because it removes most supernatural options. Its limits come from Source CL, Qi cost, setup, the target’s state, Seal Anchors, outside intervention, and explicit procedures for breaking or enduring the binding.
